backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing app features, related files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files including App, Moments page, index.css, Tailwind config, and LoveTransitionOverlay.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining color variables, dark theme overrides, and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with message carousel, Valentine interactions, transition overlay trigger, and navigation to Moments page.
frontend/src/components/LoveTransitionOv: Overlay component generating floating emojis, balloons, and hearts using random values and completing after a timed fade-out.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status flags.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive OKLCH color variables plus custom animations for romantic-themed UI in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, React Query, and the InternetIdentityProvider, then mounts the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Moments.tsx: Renders a romantic-themed page with animated floating hearts, layered backgrounds, a message card, and a photo gallery.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color tokens, fonts, animations, and plugins for the romantic design system.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, including known issues about missing heart animations and feature requirements for fixes.
